name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to Anthropic’s latest Claude 3.7 Sonnet. It’s the only model that consistently outperforms others on complex reasoning tasks—like optimizing power systems—without bloating compute costs. The trade-off is vendor lock-in to Anthropic, but the 0.5%+ capability gain outweighs that risk.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just vendor lock-in—it’s benchmark drift. EXCAVA’s live tasks (e.g., power system optimization) don’t match the static benchmarks Anthropic uses to claim superiority. Test the 3.7 Sonnet on a fresh, real-world power-grid scenario; if it fails to outperform the current model by 0.5% there, the upgrade is noise.
